selection: ephemeral CI acceptance databases only; exact active order, contract, period, change request, BASE segment and extension-detail source fingerprints are frozen and Staging/Production are rejected before credential access

lock.transactionBoundary: one serializable transaction per exact BASE segment or extension-detail candidate with a locked source rebuild before each insert

cancellation: cancel before the first transaction; any interruption after candidate execution begins requires same-operation reconcile because earlier per-candidate transactions may have committed
idempotency: existing BASE segments and extension details are preserved; reconcile verifies every approved candidate and replay creates no duplicate fact or audit
checksums: source-plan and candidate fingerprints bind feature flags, source order/change facts, versions when present, target dates, price inputs, existing facts, planned writes, audit counts and refusal classes
exitCondition: retire after ephemeral acceptance data no longer needs compatibility bootstrap for contract-change facts
